RND.description: Random Data - a request for random bytes, or the bytes.

LENGTH.description: Number of bytes requested or delivered.

BYTES.description: The random bytes; empty in a request.

GENERATED_AT_MS.description: Unix milliseconds when the bytes were generated; 0 in a request.

GENERATOR_ID.description: Identifier of the generator or beacon (a device serial, a beacon URL).

SEQUENCE.description:
Position of this block in the generator's output, for beacons and
deterministic generators; 0 = not sequenced.

SEED.description: Seed of a Deterministic generator, so the block can be reproduced.
